name: 特征分布图
description: 连接数据导入插件，选择一个特征；数值列生成 300 DPI 直方图、KDE、均值和中位数，类别列生成频数柱状图。
masterEvidence: 通过 data 输入端口接收数据导入插件输出的 CSV 文本
特征分布图升级为 2026 国赛论文级规范：300 DPI、数值 KDE、统计标注

params.label: 选择特征
params.hint: 先运行上游数据导入插件，再从 CSV 表头选择特征

code:
# 特征分布图：2026 国赛论文级数值直方图/KDE 或分类频数柱状图
import io
import base64
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from matplotlib.ticker import MaxNLocator

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.sans-serif': ['Arial', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans'],
    'axes.unicode_minus': False,
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 15,
    'axes.labelsize': 11,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9,
    'ytick.labelsize': 9,
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
    'figure.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.facecolor': 'white',
    'savefig.facecolor': 'white',
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
})

NAVY = '#1F3A93'
ORANGE = '#F39C12'
TEXT = '#333333'
GRID = '#E0E0E0'
feature = {{feature}}


def _to_frame(value):
    if isinstance(value, pd.DataFrame):
        return value.copy()
    if isinstance(value, bytes):
        text = None
        for encoding in ('utf-8-sig', 'utf-8', 'gbk', 'gb18030'):
            try:
                text = value.decode(encoding)
                break
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                continue
        if text is None:
            raise RuntimeError('CSV 编码无法识别')
        return pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(text))
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(value.lstrip('\ufeff')))
    raise RuntimeError('输入 data 必须是数据导入插件输出的 CSV 数据')


def _style_axes(ax, grid_axis='y'):
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['left'].set_color('#999999')
    ax.spines['bottom'].set_color('#999999')
    ax.spines['left'].set_linewidth(0.8)
    ax.spines['bottom'].set_linewidth(0.8)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT, direction='out', length=4)
    ax.grid(axis=grid_axis, linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5, color=GRID, alpha=0.55)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)


if data is None:
    raise RuntimeError('请先连接并运行上游的数据导入插件')
if feature is None or str(feature).strip() == '':
    raise RuntimeError('请先选择一个特征')

_df = _to_frame(data)
if feature not in _df.columns:
    raise RuntimeError('CSV 中找不到特征：' + str(feature))

_series = _df[feature].dropna()
if _series.empty:
    raise RuntimeError('所选特征没有可绘制的数据')

_numeric = pd.to_numeric(_series, errors='coerce')
_numeric_ratio = float(_numeric.notna().mean())
_fig, _ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5, 5.7))

if _numeric_ratio >= 0.8:
    _values = _numeric.dropna().astype(float)
    sns.histplot(_values, bins='auto', stat='count', kde=len(_values) >= 3 and _values.nunique() > 1, color=NAVY, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.82, ax=_ax, line_kws={'linewidth': 1.8, 'color': ORANGE})
    _mean = float(_values.mean())
    _median = float(_values.median())
    _ax.axvline(_mean, color=ORANGE, linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, label='均值 = {:.3g}'.format(_mean))
    _ax.axvline(_median, color='#27AE60', linestyle=':', linewidth=1.8, label='中位数 = {:.3g}'.format(_median))
    _ax.set_xlabel(str(feature), color=TEXT)
    _ax.set_ylabel('频数', color=TEXT)
    _ax.set_title('{} 的数值分布'.format(feature), fontweight='bold', color='#000000', pad=12)
    _ax.legend(frameon=False, loc='best')
    _fig.text(0.99, 0.01, '有效样本 n = {}；缺失值未参与绘图'.format(len(_values)), ha='right', fontsize=8, color='#666666', style='italic')
else:
    _counts_all = _series.astype(str).value_counts(dropna=False)
    _counts = _counts_all.head(30)
    _x = np.arange(len(_counts))
    _bars = _ax.bar(_x, _counts.values, width=0.72, color=NAVY, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.92)
    _ax.set_xticks(_x)
    _ax.set_xticklabels(_counts.index, rotation=35, ha='right')
    _ax.set_xlabel(str(feature), color=TEXT)
    _ax.set_ylabel('频数', color=TEXT)
    _ax.set_title('{} 的类别频数'.format(feature), fontweight='bold', color='#000000', pad=12)
    _ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(MaxNLocator(integer=True))
    _offset = max(1.0, float(_counts.max()) * 0.015)
    for _bar, _count in zip(_bars, _counts.values):
        _ax.text(_bar.get_x() + _bar.get_width() / 2, float(_count) + _offset, str(int(_count)), ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8, color=TEXT)
    _shown = len(_counts)
    _suffix = '；仅显示频数最高的 30 类' if len(_counts_all) > 30 else ''
    _fig.text(0.99, 0.01, '有效样本 n = {}；类别数 = {}{}'.format(len(_series), len(_counts_all), _suffix), ha='right', fontsize=8, color='#666666', style='italic')

_style_axes(_ax, 'y')
_fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.04, 1, 1))
_buf = io.BytesIO()
_fig.savefig(_buf, format='png', bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.18, dpi=300, facecolor='white')
plt.close(_fig)
return 'data:image/png;base64,' + base64.b64encode(_buf.getvalue()).decode()
